cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of blender-stop-condition-decider (done-condition-and-iteration-cap-pinner) with contract handoff to blender-checklist-driven-workflow
cases.inputPrompt: Use blender-stop-condition-decider on our cyberpunk shoe product-hero-v0 recipe to pin one measurable done condition, an iteration cap of 3 lookdev passes, and 4 explicit out-of-scope items.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (locked_3d_brief) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces definition_of_done_checklist, max_iteration_caps_per_stage, halt_and_escalation_triggers for role done-condition-and-iteration-cap-pinner
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to blender-checklist-driven-workflow (Per-stage workflow gates)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs definition_of_done_checklist, max_iteration_caps_per_stage, halt_and_escalation_triggers conforming to skills/blender-stop-condition-decider/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to blender-checklist-driven-workflow in skills/blender-stop-condition-decider/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete definition_of_done_checklist and hand off to blender-checklist-driven-workflow (Per-stage workflow gates).
simulatedOutput.summary: Pinned single measurable stop condition, 3-pass lookdev iteration cap, and 4 explicit out-of-scope exclusions before execution. Delivered single measurable stop condition, out-of-scope list, iteration cap and routed to blender-checklist-driven-workflow.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for blender-stop-condition-decider and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'locked_3d_brief' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar required by blender-stop-condition-decider (locked_3d_brief)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'locked_3d_brief' (target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing target deliverable specification and acceptance quality bar (locked_3d_brief) before blender-stop-condition-decider locks definition_of_done_checklist.
